systems.name: 3.1 Track Placement & Network Graph
systems.notes: Builds on the host-authoritative placement and persistence from Phase 1. The track system uses 2D billboard sprites for performance, backed by a graph for routing. Switches and junctions must be synced across clients.

tasks.notes: Performance-friendly; use the existing block placement pipeline.
Graph updates on track placed/destroyed; used for pathfinding.

tasks.text: Snap rules: straight, curve, T-junction, switch
tasks.notes: Auto-connect to nearest valid node within range.
Toggling changes graph edge connections; must be synced.
Reject orphan tracks or track floating in air.

systems.name: 3.2 Hauler Cart & Train Physics
systems.notes: Hauler physics are simple: constant speed along graph edges. Host simulates and broadcasts position; clients interpolate. Fuel consumption and cargo weight affect speed and range.

tasks.text: Train entity moving along graph (host simulated)
tasks.notes: Pathfinding uses Dijkstra on the track graph.
Incentivises upgrading carts and engines later.

tasks.text: Schedule UI: dock → signal post → return
tasks.notes: Player places signal posts as waypoints.

tasks.text: Visual: model or block structure gliding
tasks.notes: Use the custom steam-hauler model from Phase 1.
Smooth movement; similar to partner rig lerp from v14a.

systems.name: 3.3 Logistics Interface
systems.notes: UI flow for loading/unloading cargo from chests into carts, setting routes, and automated deliveries. Leverages chest sync from Phase 1.
